Installation

Requirements

  • Python 3.11+

Recommended (Conda)

Use the repository environment file: Environment name: CleanPLS

conda env create -f environment.yml
conda activate CleanPLS

The bundled environment.yml includes:

  • stable-baselines3

  • sb3-contrib (required for TRPO support)

Source-tree workflow

CleanPLS is used directly from the repository in the documented research workflow. After activating the Conda environment, run examples and tests from the repository root. Python resolves the local pls package from the source tree, so no separate distribution installation is required.

The environment specification includes the documentation dependencies.

Build documentation

Command: make -C docs html

make -C docs html
